WRF damp_opt=3 is implicit gravity-wave damping over the top zdamp metres; ERF's analog is Rayleigh damping on w toward wbar with a sine-squared ramp (ERF_MakeMomSources.cpp:485-494, ERF_InitRayleigh.cpp:42-51). zdamp=5000 and dampcoef=0.2 carry over exactly; wbar is zero-filled (ERF_InitRayleigh.cpp:29-30) and no sounding overwrites it on the WRFInput path, so w is damped toward zero as in WRF. ERF ships two YSU implementations; "YSU" is a partial port that aborts on unstable conditions (ERF_ComputeDiffusivityYSU.cpp) which this August coastal case hits at step 1. "YSUNew" is the full port with no stability or zref restriction, so it is the faithful translation of bl_pbl_physics=1

WRF's YSU applies its vertical diffusion with an implicit tridiagonal solve over the whole step; there is no namelist key because it is never explicit. ERF's factors are per RK3 stage and default to 1 1 0, leaving the third stage explicit. With YSU K of 40-60 m2/s on 17-19 m layers over the White Mountains escarpment (i=448, j=338, a 745 m drop in one 2 km cell) the explicit diffusion number K*dt/dz^2 reaches 1.6 against a limit of 0.5, and a two-cell vertical mode grows from t=70 s and kills ERF step 10 (out_flux_diag.txt). All stages implicit matches WRF and ran the full cadence clean (out_flux_candidate.txt). Horizontal filters (erf.num_diff_coeff=0.12, les_type=Smagorinsky2D) and erf.gradp_type=1 were tested and did not help
